summary: Frontend-only verification of the three iteration-18 export fixes. All three PASS. Fix 1 (dynamic idle deadline) verified both by source-review of constants (BASE_IDLE_MS=360_000, PER_PAGE_MS=3_000, MAX_IDLE_MS=1_200_000 at /app/frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.jsx lines 225-234) AND by running the exact JS formula in-browser via page.evaluate — computed outputs (1p=363_000, 3p=369_000, 32p=456_000, 64p=552_000, 300p=1_200_000) match the spec bit-for-bit. Fix 3 (Recent Exports cookie fallback) verified live end-to-end: (a) with Authorization header + valid token in localStorage → GET /api/admin/recent-exports = 200; (b) after localStorage.removeItem('bindery_token') the same call with credentials:'include' STILL returns 200 via the httpOnly access_token cookie set at login — this was the exact user-reported bug and it is fixed. Fix 2 (Check again recovery) source-verified: recoveryAction is only offered when isTimeout && cancelState.jobId, all four branches (ready → anchor download + success toast + exportsBump; failed → surface backend error; pending → 'Still rendering ({stage}). Try Check again in ~30 s.'; 404 → 'Job no longer available on the server — please re-export.') are correctly coded, and the recovery endpoint /api/books/{id}/pdf-jobs/{job_id} is reachable and returns proper 404 (not 5xx) for missing jobs — dry-run confirmed. Full live simulation of Fix 2 would require an artificial 6+ min timeout in the browser and was not attempted in a single iteration (impractical to run in test window); the branch logic is small, straightforward, and source-inspected. Regression sweep passed: login OK; editor loads (Belinda 32-page book); Export PDF popover opens; all promised data-testids present (export-pdf-button, export-popover, export-whole-book, export-print, export-range-start, export-range-end, export-range-submit, export-coverage-bar, export-cover-spread); no console errors during the happy path.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix 2 recovery branch source-reviewed only — live UI simulation of a 6+ min stage-idle timeout was skipped because it is not practical inside a single testing iteration. If the main agent wants a live UI test, wire an internal debug hook (or a very short debug-mode idle deadline, e.g. 5 s via env or query param) so Playwright can force the timeout branch quickly and click the Check-again toast action. Currently the branch is exercised only by unit/manual test.

RecentExportsDialog auto-load on `if (open && data === null && !loading && !error) load()` runs during render — this is a mild side-effect-in-render pattern. Works today because the guard prevents a loop, but converting to useEffect(() => { if (open) load(); }, [open]) is cleaner and matches React idioms. Not blocking.

The dynamic-deadline formula in usePdfExport.jsx (lines 225-234) does not account for cover-spread exports which only render a single spread but still get pagesInExport ≥ 1 (fine — floor keeps 6 min minimum). No issue, just noting.

usePdfExport.jsx is now 577 lines — still under the 700-line threshold, but the recovery block (lines 453-549) is a good candidate to extract into a helper `buildRecoveryAction({jobId, bookId, book, toastId, authHeaders, setExportsBump})` for testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 fixes verified, all regression checks pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix 2's 'Check again' recovery is source-verified but not live-clicked. If a future iteration wants end-to-end UI proof, either (a) temporarily set STAGE_IDLE_DEADLINE_MS to a small value via a debug hook so Playwright can force the timeout in <30 s, or (b) use page.route() to intercept /api/books/*/pdf-jobs/* and drive the four branches deterministically — but note the fetch happens INSIDE the async onExportPdf function, so the interception must be armed BEFORE clicking Export-PDF. Fix 3's cookie fallback proven working live — the httpOnly access_token cookie IS set by /api/auth/login (visible via credentials:'include' round-trip even though document.cookie is empty because it's httpOnly). Recent-exports endpoint honours EITHER the Bearer header OR the cookie via backend/auth.py::_extract_token.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration was a fix-verification pass, not a bug reproduction. The three fixes address the user-observed symptom that a 41/64-page export appeared to fail on the frontend while the backend had actually finished. Root cause was a 6-minute wall-clock ceiling that didn't scale with book size (Fix 1), no recovery path once the timeout error fired (Fix 2), and RecentExportsDialog silently dropped its auth when localStorage was empty (Fix 3). All three RCA hypotheses are now closed with code.
